The ETR for Q1 FY27 reflects the same and stood at 29.4%.
I still maintain that net of all the investments that we continue to make in the business, we should expect margins to be at or about 15% or slightly better than that.
Growth & demand: We've delivered a revenue growth of 0.3% in constant currency quarter -on-quarter.
In rupee terms, Q1 revenue was INR1,379.4 crore, a growth of 2.3% quarter -on-quarter.
Now while this quarter, you see a little bit of a lesser order book, but if you compare it to Q1 of last year, when we delivered about $140 million, this quarter has bee n a 20% growth.
Margins & costs: Our EBITDA margins have normalized to 16.1% without any one-off items like we had in the past quarter, and it is closer to our sustainable range.
In that backdrop, I'm pleased to note that we have delivered a healthy EBITDA margin, as Angan pointed out, of 16.1% for the quarter.
So, on the margins, like I have been maintaining, we will continue to push for a 15%-plus EBITDA margin.
Capex & expansion: And they have genuinely utilized to the extent going into a net debt than going net cash, either via acquisitions; and few others who had cash, they did very large buybacks, meaning the rightful owners get their rightful cash right, in case the management doesn't have that plans to utilize.
I'm reasonably confident that if we can continue to show order book momentum and invest in the right places, revenues will eventually come.
See, we will never ever do an acquisition for revenue aggregation, that we will not do.
Balance sheet & cash: This will leverage Birlasoft's AI framework, delivering faster software deve lopment, optimizing operating costs, enhancing customer experience and improving agility.
Coming to the balance sheet, we maintained our strong track record on collections and cash flow generation during the quarter under review with quarterly collection increasing to $163.1 million.
